description: gte-modernbert-base full fine-tune (lr 3e-5, 3 epochs, bs 32, max_len 128, early stop on 10% held-out silver), 5-fold cross-fit over eval_inputs (protocol.eval_folds): each fold model trains on the v1 seeded LLM labels (deepseek-v4.1-flash, v1 seed examples) of the other 4 folds (+20 eval texts that v1 used as its seeds, relabeled with the v2 seeds) and scores only its held-out fold. Exported to ONNX and dynamically quantised to int8 (per-channel). Threshold 0.5: dev mean F1 over the 5 int8 fold models is flat at 0.966 for 0.40-0.55; 0.60 was 0.970 (one dev example) and rejected as noise. Labeler on dev: v1 seeded F1 0.957 / v1 plain 0.909.
